lesson.grammar_point: present simple negative and questions (do / does / don't / doesn't)

listenings.text: Hello, this is Peter from the supplier in Rotterdam. I have information about your order. The material does not leave this week, because the truck does not arrive on time. It leaves on Monday, and the delivery is here in ten days. We do not change the price. Please confirm the new deadline by email. Thank you.

Hi, this is Claire. A quick note about deadlines. In our group, we do not confirm a deadline by phone. We confirm it by email, always. If the supplier does not answer in two days, you call the purchasing team in France. It is a small rule, but it makes a big difference. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo receives an email from the supplier. He does not understand one number, so he asks a question. The supplier answers the question in ten minutes. Rodrigo confirms the new deadline by email. The delivery arrives on time.
